objective: GET /events/games/recent lists the newest games first by calendar day, and ranks games by standings only within a day.
acceptance_criteria: Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation; the implementation commit edits no test.

The list is ordered by the game's calendar date (the date part of games.date, as stored), newest first; within one date, by the sum of the two teams' current-season standings ranks, ascending (EVENTS-013's rank); then start time, newest first; then id, descending.

Candidates are every completed game on the most recent N completed dates, where N is the request's limit (each date has at least one game, so the list fills whenever at least limit completed games exist). Example pinned by a test: limit 5, 3 games on the newest date and 8 on the day before gives the newest date's 3 in rank order, then the day before's best-ranked 2.
The statement count stays three whatever the limit (candidates with their dates subquery, teams, batched records), pinned by the existing count test.
The response schema, the limit bounds (1-10, default 5), ranks and records are unchanged; only the order and the candidate window change. The route's docstring and 0x02-events.md say the new order.

The containerized backend suite, ruff and mypy pass. backend/openapi.json and frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts are regenerated from the app and committed with the implementation; wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x02-events.md is updated where this unit changes a documented fact.
No migration and no frontend change beyond the regenerated schema.d.ts (Recent Games renders the API's order).
